translated: But I don't really see the MMJ members... well,
I can imagine Hon-chan and Yoshioka-san drinking,
but I can't really picture the two of you doing that.
What do you like to drink when you're eating?
I can definitely see you drinking tea.
I see. Then you'd probably enjoy Oita's tea and shochu.
They also mentioned a school festival, so I hope they have fun.
University festivals are pretty free, aren't they?
Like you can do whatever you want, or how should I put it...
Compared to high school or middle school.
Ah, because you do it all yourselves.
Some universities even invite voice actors for talk shows.
Since you can do things like that.
You can really do a lot more on your own.
